retention.image: Keep exactly the tag registered in shared.json for as long as this profile exists; a superseded Strata tag is removed reference-aware, never with a blanket prune. Exception, dated: while the 0.1.44.1 candidate is under evaluation (from 2026-10-15) both it and the 0.1.43 tag it may be rolled back to stay registered, so that rolling back is a profile change and not a second drain to re-add an entry; when the candidate is decided, the losing entry and its tag go.
retention.model: The UD-Q4_K_XL shards are retained only while this profile is registered; retiring the profile releases them to the library retention pass like any other revision.
retention.workspace: ai/strata-xl-trial/data holds the engine pack, its MTP layer and its own logs; it is bounded by the engine and is removed with the profile.
retention.reports: Trial measurements go to ops/reports/<date>-strata-trial and follow the existing reports aging convention.

labels.local-ai.retention: reference-aware: tag, model revision and workspace are released with the profile

catalog.quantization: Unsloth Dynamic UD-Q4_K_XL (~4-bit, 111 GB, K-quant experts)

mtp.detail: the engine's own MTP draft layer, installed with its state on first start; automatic drafting is left on

deployment_warnings: Trial profile: it is reached through its own service alias, trial-xl, and never through daytime, local-active or nighttime, so it is never a default and never shadows the selected profile. Only an operator who chose this configuration sends trial.

While this profile is active the catalog offers no daytime service at all: daytime is genuinely absent, not merely another name for this backend, and a request for it fails as MODEL_NOT_FOUND. A client that only ever sends daytime has nothing to send until a Daytime profile is selected again.

Strata is not llama.cpp: it configures itself from the environment, keeps its own pack, logs and MTP layer in ai/strata-trial/data, and needs a writable root. Unrestricted output is stated because the deployment sets no output ceiling; it has not been attested on this quant, which is a plain Qwen release rather than an unrestricted fine-tune. nsfw is therefore false.
Exclusive profile: Nighttime is stopped and removed while this profile is active; requests for it fail until a paired Daytime profile is selected.

Four text cards only (RTX 3090, RTX 4080 SUPER, RTX 4080, 3080 Ti) with auto layer placement; the RTX 3080 is not in this container at all, so this backend serves no vision and the shared projector path is idle.

Prompt chunks stay at the engine's own 8192. STRATA_PREFILL_AUTO_MAX=16384 was tried on 2026-10-14 and made long prefill worse: -5.5% at 16K and -5.9% at 32K against +0.3% at 4K, on a suite that repeats within 0.2%. `auto` only took 9216 tokens, because the ceiling was never the limit, and the bigger chunk borrows more expert-cache slots to hold its buffers (6,933 against 6,281), which is the wrong trade where PCIe already reports pcie_frac 0.22. Anything that lends fewer experts to the prompt path has to be measured against the experts it evicts, not against the chunk it enables.

STRATA_HC_Q8=1 was measured on 2026-10-14 and reverted: mean decode +1.1%, under the 3% bar this instrument resolves and negative on two of five cells, against prefill -8.2% to -15.5% and first token 9-18% slower. Q8_0 hyper-connection bytes are wider than the quantized ones, so on a box at pcie_frac 0.22 the prompt path pays for them on every token it reads. It also changed the answers -- the code cell stopped at 156 tokens where the baseline ran to 256 -- so the accuracy claim is unproven rather than merely small, and an unproven accuracy gain does not buy a 15% prefill loss.

This profile exists to measure one variable: UD-Q4_K_XL against UD-IQ4_XS on the same engine, the same four cards and the same arguments. What it is testing is expert residency, not bit depth. 0.1.44.1 writes no --resident-budget-gib when the experts fit beside 16 GiB of working set (77.0 + 16.0 = 93.0 GiB against 123.2 GiB of RAM here), which on paper puts every expert in RAM and deletes the cold path this house measured at 30-60% below warm. Two things could still stop that: split_budget() is unchanged between the versions and drops --resident-budget-gib on a layer split anyway (#498), and the release figures were measured in single-GPU arena mode, not across four cards. Read the engine start-up log for the residency it actually reached before believing any number from this profile.
160K is the total prompt, history, reasoning, and output capacity.

A fresh container reads all 111 GB of its four shards before it answers, because the engine keeps its verified-checksum markers in its own tree rather than beside the read-only model files; the readiness window allows for it.
